turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hi, how are things with you?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: It's my turn to pick the book for our book club.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Nice. What does the group usually enjoy, and would you rather pick something safe or something that sparks a big debate?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Hang on, I'm going to chat with my friend for a bit. Just wait until I say I'm back.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Ryan, have you seen my charger? The white one with the short cable.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: I borrowed it this morning, sorry. It's next to my bed.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Can I grab it? I'm down to five percent.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Go for it. We really need to buy a second one.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Agreed. Maybe a long cable so it reaches the couch.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Good idea. Add it to the shopping list.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I'm back, sorry for the wait.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: No problem. You were choosing a book club pick, safe or debate-worthy?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Safe. Last month's pick nearly started a fight.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Understood. A warm, funny family story is a crowd pleaser and still gives you plenty to discuss.
